External construction function validating config shares and binding storage.

edges.reason: initialize binds poolAddress to msg.sender and mints/provides liquidity based on caller-controlled invocation.
mine() is unauthenticated; any msg.sender can execute mining steps and receive rewards.
claimWinnerPrize relies on msg.sender for winner identity and claim bookkeeping.
getUnclaimedPrizes is guarded by poolOnly, comparing msg.sender to poolAddress.
finish_randomnessProviderCallback is guarded by randomnessProviderOnly using msg.sender.
generateReferralID derives referral identity from msg.sender.
registerReferral uses msg.sender as the referree being registered.
checkForEnding compares now - startDate against maxLifetime, a timestamp dependency.
checkFinishingStageConditions uses now - startDate for lifetime and minTimeActive criteria.
getUnclaimedPrizes checks now - completionDate against prizeClaimTime.
initialize stores startDate = now and uses now for deadline and transferHashValue.
generateReferralID hashes now into the referral ID, making it timestamp dependent.
mine() performs an ETH transfer to msg.sender, an external call performed around the mutex flag.
claimWinnerPrize transfers ETH to msg.sender, allowing recipient code execution.
getUnclaimedPrizes transfers the entire balance to the pool address, an external call.
mine_removeUniswapLiquidityAndTransferProfits transfers owner share via OWNER_ADDRESS.transfer.
Profit transfer calls external IUniLotteryPool.lotteryFinish with value, invoking pool code mid-operation.
LotteryStub fallback delegatecalls into __delegateContract, executing external code in the stub's context.
_transfer calls checkFinishingStageConditions after each transfer.
_transfer calls checkForEnding when on the finishing stage.
_transfer calls updateHolderData_preTransfer before finalizing the transfer.
mine() invokes executeWinnerSelectionAlgorithm on the storage contract.
mine() invokes mine_removeUniswapLiquidityAndTransferProfits on step 0.
claimWinnerPrize calls getWinnerPrizeAmount to compute the payout.
updateHolderData_preTransfer calls updateAndPropagateScoreChanges on the storage.
lotteryStage is read by onlyOnStage(ENDING_MINING) in mine().
lotteryStage is read by onlyOnStage(COMPLETION) in claimWinnerPrize.
checkForEnding depends on the current lotteryStage transitions.
mine() checks and sets reEntrancyMutexLocked manually around the reward transfer.
claimWinnerPrize uses the mutexLOCKED modifier backed by reEntrancyMutexLocked.
getUnclaimedPrizes uses the mutexLOCKED modifier backed by reEntrancyMutexLocked.
finish_timeRandomSeedRequested feeds alternativeSeedGenerationPossible used by ending checks.
transferHashValue is modulo-tested in checkForEnding to decide ending.
prizeClaimersAddresses is read/written in claimWinnerPrize to prevent double claims.
ending_profitAmount is the basis of prize computations in getWinnerPrizeAmount.
ending_profitAmount is used to compute miner rewards in mine().
randomSeed is consumed to build randomized final scores in winner selection.
holders array is iterated to compute final scores and winner ordering.
holderData is updated and propagated through the referral chain.
completionDate is checked against the prize deadline in getUnclaimedPrizes.
sender parameter flows into _transfer account checks and burns.
receiver parameter flows into _transfer balance and max-balance checks.
amount parameter determines burn and final transfer amounts in _transfer.
rankingPosition supplied by caller is validated and used for prize computation.
randomSeed parameter is forwarded to lotStorage.setRandomSeed.
burnAmount local is derived from amount and burn rates inside _transfer.
finalAmount local is the post-burn amount transferred in _transfer.
holderCountChanged local gates the finishing probability update in _transfer.
currentStepReward local is the amount sent through the miner reward transfer.
individualToReferralRatio local scales referree scores in winner selection.
maxAvailablePlayerScore local clamps normalized scores in winner selection.
SCORE_RAND_FACT local scales scores before randomization in winner selection.

normalization_plan.reason: sender is a transient argument used only by the _transfer function.
receiver is a transient argument used only by the _transfer function.
amount is a transient argument used only by the _transfer function.
rankingPosition is caller-supplied input consumed by claimWinnerPrize.
randomSeed is the callback argument stored by finish_randomnessProviderCallback.
burnAmount is an intermediate computed value inside _transfer.
finalAmount is an intermediate computed value inside _transfer.
holderCountChanged is an intermediate flag used within _transfer logic.
currentStepReward is the value sent by the miner reward unsafe transfer.
individualToReferralRatio is a normalization local used by the winner selection algorithm.
maxAvailablePlayerScore is a normalization local used by the winner selection algorithm.
SCORE_RAND_FACT is a normalization local used by the winner selection algorithm.
